edges.reason: msg.sender is read as the balance owner in transfer.
msg.sender is used as the allowance owner key in approve.
msg.sender is used as the spender key when decrementing _allowed in transferFrom.
msg.sender is used as the allowance owner key in increaseAllowance.
msg.sender is used as the allowance owner key in decreaseAllowance.
msg.sender becomes _owner and the funded and whitelisted account in the constructor.
transfer subtracts from _balances[msg.sender] and adds to _balances[to].
transfer reduces _totalSupply by tokensToBurn.
transfer branches on _checkWhitelist(msg.sender)/_checkWhitelist(to) to bypass cap and burn.
transferFrom mutates _balances[from] and _balances[to].
transferFrom reads and, in the non-whitelist branch, subtracts the allowance.
transferFrom reduces _totalSupply by tokensToBurn.
approve writes _allowed[msg.sender][spender] = value.
increaseAllowance adds to _allowed[msg.sender][spender].
decreaseAllowance subtracts from _allowed[msg.sender][spender].
constructor assigns _owner = msg.sender, granting privileged state.
constructor mints the whole supply to _balances[_owner].
constructor internally calls _modifyWhitelist for the owner and the router.
_modifyWhitelist writes the privileged _whitelist mapping with no access control.
transfer calls _checkWhitelist to decide cap/burn bypass.
transferFrom calls _checkWhitelist to decide cap/burn bypass.
transfer calls findBurnAmount to compute the burn.
transferFrom calls findBurnAmount to compute the burn.
burnPct is passed as the rate argument into findBurnAmount.
transfer feeds user-controlled value into unchecked burn and supply arithmetic.
transferFrom feeds user-controlled value into unchecked balance/allowance/burn arithmetic.
_modifyWhitelist feeds an unguarded privilege flag into the whitelist/cap bypass state.
to parameter flows into transfer recipient handling.
value parameter flows into balance, cap and burn arithmetic in transfer.
tokensToBurn local is derived from value and used to reduce supply in transfer.
tokensToTransfer local is the credited amount in transfer.
spender parameter flows into _allowed key in approve.
value parameter is stored as the allowance in approve.
from parameter flows into balance and allowance lookups in transferFrom.
to parameter flows into recipient handling in transferFrom.
value parameter flows into balance, allowance and burn arithmetic in transferFrom.
tokensToBurn local reduces _totalSupply in transferFrom.
tokensToTransfer local is the credited amount in transferFrom.
spender parameter flows into _allowed key in increaseAllowance.
addedValue parameter is added to the allowance.
spender parameter flows into _allowed key in decreaseAllowance.
subtractedValue parameter is subtracted from the allowance.
adr parameter becomes the whitelist key.
state parameter becomes the whitelist boolean value.
rate parameter is multiplied into the burn amount.
value parameter is ceilinged and scaled in findBurnAmount.

normalization_plan.reason: Recipient parameter belongs to transfer; fold into the function node.
Amount parameter is consumed by transfer arithmetic and cap checks.
tokensToBurn is a transfer-local derived value.
tokensToTransfer is a transfer-local derived value.
Value parameter is consumed by transferFrom arithmetic and cap checks.
tokensToBurn is a transferFrom-local derived value.
tokensToTransfer is a transferFrom-local derived value.
addedValue parameter is used in the allowance addition.
subtractedValue parameter is used in the allowance subtraction.
adr parameter is written into the privileged _whitelist mapping.
state parameter is written into the privileged _whitelist mapping.
rate parameter drives the burn calculation.
value parameter drives the burn calculation.
